tasks.corrected_reference_answer: The cache flag retains a RegularGridInterpolator for reuse; disabling it recomputes the domain, mesh and convolution on every call (astropy/modeling/convolution.py:68-85). Increasing the step size generally reduces the number of grid points, hence the grid storage and computation, because the domain uses np.arange(..., resolution) (astropy/modeling/bounding_box.py:133-134). Runtime changes to _resolution alone do not invalidate an existing cache: call clear_cache() or create a new model before evaluating the changed grid (astropy/modeling/convolution.py:61-80). Caching saves repeated convolution work at the cost of retaining grid data; disabling caching removes retained cache storage, but still needs temporary computation memory.

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: The code alone does not establish a general concurrency scaling failure. GeoSeries/GeoDataFrame.sindex delegates to the geometry array (geopandas/base.py:4938), whose property lazily caches SpatialIndex (geopandas/array.py:335-341). Construction copies the geometry array and creates a Shapely STRtree (geopandas/sindex.py:25-35). Queries delegate to that tree and optionally sort or construct dense/sparse NumPy/SciPy outputs (geopandas/sindex.py:210-243). Index rebuilding and large outputs can add cost, but attributing a particular slowdown to serialization, GIL contention or pandas alignment requires the actual operation, data, object-reuse pattern and measurements.

tasks.corrected_reference_answer: getitem obtains a new module collection and generates items, so repeated calls may repeat collection work (src/_pytest/pytester.py:1254-1283,1308-1317). String xfail conditions are compiled and evaluated each time evaluate_condition is reached (src/_pytest/skipping.py:97-118). evaluate_xfail_marks itself does not read or populate a cache, even on the same Item (src/_pytest/skipping.py:213-235). The runtest hooks store and reuse xfailed_key separately, and reevaluate when it is None (src/_pytest/skipping.py:238-268). _mod_collections caches collect_by_name results for an existing collector, not arbitrary getitem invocations (src/_pytest/pytester.py:1319-1332). Reusing collected items can avoid collection work, but caching condition results across evaluations requires preserving dynamic-condition semantics; measuring AST/import costs needs the actual invocation and cache behavior.
